page: Microsoft Azure L96as_v4 is a storage-optimized virtual machine tailored for data-dense workloads requiring substantial local throughput and memory capacity. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance is driven by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor delivering up to 3.7 GHz across 48 physical cores and 96 dedicated vCPUs with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU supports modern instruction sets including AVX-512 extensions (f, vnni, and bf16) along with hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Hardware resource allocation is balanced for intensive concurrent data processing, featuring 768 GB of system memory (8 GB per vCPU) paired directly with 23,040 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. There are no discrete GPUs included on this instance type. Network connectivity does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, relying on private networking topologies or virtual network gateways standard to Azure environments.

Benchmarking data highlights robust parallel computing and high-throughput memory operations. The instance achieved top-tier rankings in stress-ng multi-core processing (147,596.42), PassMark CPU score (92,661.83), and Geekbench multi-core testing (22,976.0), alongside strong single-core ratings. Cryptographic throughput reached the top 10% in PassMark encryption testing (112,423.0). Memory subsystems delivered 229.38 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 140.83 GB/sec in write operations. Key-value operations also demonstrated notable efficiency, achieving 122.77 million Redis SET operations per second.

With its dense configuration of 23 TB local NVMe storage and 768 GB RAM, the L96as_v4 offers high resource density on a single virtual host, eliminating external disk latency for data-heavy pipelines. However, workloads requiring hardware graphics acceleration or dynamic GPU execution are unsupported. This server type is best suited for large relational databases, distributed NoSQL databases, transactional processing, data warehousing, and large-scale data engineering jobs.
description: Microsoft Azure L96as_v4 is a storage-optimized virtual machine designed for high-throughput, data-intensive workloads. Powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9V74 processor featuring 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs running at 3.7 GHz, it is equipped with 768 GB of system memory and 23,040 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It does not include dedicated GPU hardware. Benchmark evaluations place the instance in the top tier for multi-core compute metrics, including Geekbench multi-core (22,976.0) and PassMark CPU (92,661.83), backed by strong uncached memory bandwidth of 229.38 GB/sec read and 140.83 GB/sec write. In-memory data store performance is underscored by 122.77 million Redis SET operations per second. The L96as_v4 provides high internal I/O throughput and resource density, making it well fitted for large transactional databases, distributed NoSQL engines, analytics pipelines, and data-heavy processing clusters.
